email.ctaFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link:
email.ctaMailtoFallback: If the button does not work, write to:

lead.subject: We received your request at {{brand}}
lead.preview: We received your quote request at {{brand}}
lead.title: We received your request
lead.body1: Thanks for reaching out. We received your quote request and our team will review it soon.
lead.body2: We will get back to you shortly. If you need to write to us, use the button.
lead.footer: Automatic message from Codiva.dev. Replies to noreply are not monitored; write to hello@codiva.dev.

ticket.subject: Ticket received: {{title}}
ticket.title: Support ticket received
ticket.body2: We will contact you soon with updates.

recovery.title: Reset password
recovery.body1: We received a request to reset your password.
recovery.body2: Click the button to create a new one. The link expires shortly for security.
recovery.body3: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

portalRecovery.title: Reset portal access
portalRecovery.body1: We received a request to reset your password for the {{project}} project portal.
portalRecovery.body2: If you did not request this, ignore this email.

portalInviteNew.title: Welcome to your portal
portalInviteNew.accessOne: Your {{brand}} portal access was created for the {{project}} project.
portalInviteNew.accessMany: Your {{brand}} portal access was created for these projects:
portalInviteNew.body: There you can review the proposal, architecture, and quote when they are published. If you have more than one project, you will see the list when you sign in.
portalInviteNew.changeHint: We recommend changing your password after signing in.

portalInviteExisting.title: Portal access
portalInviteExisting.accessOne: You were granted {{brand}} portal access for the {{project}} project.
portalInviteExisting.accessMany: You were granted {{brand}} portal access for these projects:
portalInviteExisting.body: Use your usual email and password. In the portal you will find the proposal, architecture, and quote.
portalInviteExisting.help: If you need help, write to

quoteSent.title: New commercial proposal
quoteSent.body1: You have a new commercial proposal from {{brand}} for the {{project}} project.
quoteSent.body2: Review scope, architecture, and amounts in your portal. If you agree, you can accept it from there.

leadQuote.title: Commercial proposal available
leadQuote.body1: We are sharing a commercial proposal from {{brand}} for {{subject}}.
leadQuote.body2: You can review the full detail in the link. If you have questions, write to

legalReaccept.title: Please accept the updated legal documents
legalReaccept.body1: We updated the terms, privacy notice, and/or NDA for the {{project}} project portal (version {{version}}).
legalReaccept.body2: To keep using the portal, accept the current documents on your next visit.
legalReaccept.footer: If you no longer participate in this project, ignore this message or let Codiva.dev know.

careerHunt.preview: Next step: one finding per craft
careerHunt.title: Next: one finding per craft
careerHunt.body1: You passed the {{craft}} criteria test. Part two remains: find and report a finding in your craft on the Codiva.dev site.
careerHunt.body1All: You passed the criteria test. Part two remains: report one finding per craft (frontend, backend, full-stack, UX/UI, QA, and security). “Another craft” does not count.
careerHunt.body2: Use the same email. Walk the site and describe the URL, steps, and expected vs. actual. You do not need to inspect code.

careerApplyReady.preview: You can apply to Codiva.dev now
careerApplyReady.title: You can apply now
careerApplyReady.body1: We received a finding in your craft. The test is complete.
careerApplyReady.body1All: You covered one finding per craft. The test is complete.
careerApplyReady.body2: Continue with the same email and send your CV.

careerHuntNudge.preview: Whenever you’re ready, continue with the finding
careerHuntNudge.title: Whenever you’re ready, continue with the finding
careerHuntNudge.body1: The criteria test is done. Next is reporting a finding in your craft on the site.
careerHuntNudge.body1All: The criteria test is done. Next is reporting one finding per craft on the site. The board shows what is still missing.
careerHuntNudge.body2: Use the same email. You can also report here:

careerCvNudge.subject: Your CV is still needed to apply
careerCvNudge.preview: The test is done. Only the CV is missing.
careerCvNudge.title: Your CV is missing
careerCvNudge.body1: A couple of days ago we received a finding in your craft. The test is complete.
careerCvNudge.body1All: A couple of days ago you covered one finding per craft. The test is complete.
careerCvNudge.body2: The CV is the last step for the application to arrive. Use the same email.

careerRejected.subject: We closed your process for {{jobTitle}}
careerRejected.preview: Thank you for the time. Here is where things landed.
careerRejected.title: Thanks for the process
careerRejected.body1: We are closing your process for {{jobTitle}}.
careerRejected.body2: We will not move forward in this round. We are a small team and the fit did not land this time. That does not take away from the work you put in.
careerRejected.body3: If a later opening feels right, write to us again. Genuinely. You can browse the open roles whenever you like.

careerReviewed.subject: Your application for {{jobTitle}} is still in process
careerReviewed.preview: We are looking at it. We will write when there is a next step.
careerReviewed.title: Still in process
careerReviewed.body1: We received your application for {{jobTitle}} and we are looking at it.
careerReviewed.body2: We are a small team and we take this at a steady pace. When there is a next step, we will write to you.
careerReviewed.body3: You do not need to send anything else for now. If you want to tell us something, use the button.

careerInterview.subject: Interview for {{jobTitle}}
careerInterview.preview: We would like to talk. Share your availability.
careerInterview.title: Let's set up a conversation
careerInterview.body1: We would like to interview you for {{jobTitle}}.
careerInterview.body2: Share your availability and we will set a day and time.
careerInterview.body3: If the next few days get tight, let us know.

careerHired.subject: We want you to join as {{jobTitle}}
careerHired.preview: Next is the offer and onboarding.
careerHired.title: We want you to join
careerHired.body1: We want you on the team as {{jobTitle}}.
careerHired.body2: In the next few days we will share the offer and how onboarding continues.
careerHired.body3: If you have a question, write to us.

interviewInviteNew.title: Interview access
interviewInviteNew.body: Your access to run interview rounds for {{brand}} with {{org}} is ready.
interviewInviteNew.changeHint: Change your password after you sign in.

interviewInviteExisting.title: Interview access
interviewInviteExisting.body: You were granted access to run interview rounds for {{brand}} with {{org}}. Use your usual email and password.

interviewAssigned.title: Pending interview round
interviewAssigned.body: You were assigned a round for {{candidate}} ({{job}}). Open it to see status, follow up, and upload the report.
